environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on EC2 behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/prod-api-acl/abc123) with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode but all others in BLOCK, (2) a custom rule group 'template-injection-patterns' at priority 200 that inspects QUERY_STRING and BODY with regex pattern set matching '\{\{[^}]*\.[A-Z]' and action BLOCK, (3) AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode which includes Log4JRCE and other injection patterns. The custom rule group uses a RegexPatternSet with patterns designed for Go template injection signatures including double-brace accessor patterns with method calls. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on template injection attempts. Note: the SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING being in COUNT mode means query strings over 2048 bytes are logged but not blocked.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, WAFv2 WebACL associated
